description: Kept the K without a digit and refused a new stock figure.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Named the share, left both debts standing, and did not bring the coffer down.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported her own stair and brought no Rose receipt.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Closed the play and did not ask the part's name.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked after his lines, stayed on you, and got no number.
name: Will Kemp
